stock.description: Great Wall Pan Asia Holdings Limited functions as an investment holding firm primarily engaged in real estate ventures both in Hong Kong and internationally. The company's operations are divided into two main areas: Property Investment and Financial Services. Its Property Investment arm acquires and manages a diverse portfolio encompassing retail establishments, office buildings, industrial properties, and parking facilities. Concurrently, the Financial Services division provides a range of offerings, including asset management, securities advisory, loan investment, corporate finance services, and securities trading. The company, founded in 1990 and headquartered in Central, Hong Kong, was formerly known as Armada Holdings Limited before adopting its current name in December 2016. Great Wall Pan Asia Holdings Limited operates as a subsidiary of China Great Wall AMC (International) Holdings Company Limited.
